name: Marketing Skills
works_with: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf and any agent that supports the Agent Skills spec
short: A library of marketing skills for your coding agent: conversion, copywriting, SEO, analytics, ads, email and growth.
what: Corey Haines' collection of AI agent skills for marketing work, from landing page conversion and copywriting to SEO audits, analytics tracking, ads, pricing and launches. A product-marketing skill holds your product, audience and positioning, and the other skills read it before doing anything.
who: Technical marketers and founders who already use a coding agent. If you're new to the terminal, the README points to a companion guide, Coding for Marketers.
needs: A coding agent that supports skills

steps.title: Install all the skills
steps.text: The CLI finds the agents you have and asks where to install.

steps.title: Or just a few
steps.code: npx skills add coreyhaines31/marketingskills --skill cro copywriting

steps.title: Running it from inside Claude Code?
steps.text: Name the agent, or the skills may land in a folder Claude Code doesn't read.

steps.title: Or use the Claude Code plugin
steps.code:
claude plugin marketplace add coreyhaines31/marketingskills
claude plugin install marketing-skills@marketingskills

steps.title: In Codex
steps.text: Then open /plugins in a Codex session and pick marketing-skills.

try.label: From the README
try.text:
Help me optimize this landing page for conversions

Or call a skill directly: /cro, /emails, /seo-audit

watch: The README lists paid partners (Converly and Ploy) whose integrations are documented next to neutral options. It says partners don't influence what the core skills recommend.
Upgrading from v1.x leaves old skill folders next to the new ones. The README gives the cleanup command and a rename map.
/plugin only works in an interactive Claude Code CLI session, not on the web or in GitHub Actions.
